structured_output.what_is_happening: SHIBABRAIN is a pump.fun coin created about 29 hours before migration. It moved to PumpSwap at 05:13 UTC and ran to an all-time high of about $875k market cap (GMGN ath_price 0.000875). By detection it had fallen to $273k, and when I re-checked DexScreener live during research it was at about $123k: -67% over 5 minutes, liquidity down to $31k, and about $1.09M in total volume. The story copies the September 2026 fruit-fly connectome memecoin meta ($FLYBRAIN, flycoin), which grew out of the Janelia/Google male Drosophila connectome release. This coin says it is a Shiba Inu run by a '158,262-neuron brain sim'. I found no real dog connectome release; the neuron count looks like fly-scale. The wallet mix is heavily bot-driven: 501 bundler wallets, 973 fresh wallets, and a 42% bot/degen rate. At least 9 other SHIBABRAIN clones launched within the hour.

narrative.description: A spin-off of the 'real connectome brain launches or trades a memecoin' meta, which started with the fruit fly connectome ($FLYBRAIN reached about $60M in September 2026). Here the fly is swapped for a Shiba Inu 'scanned dog connectome' brain. That claim appears fabricated: I found no news of a dog connectome, and the website describes a 158k-neuron sim, which is fly-scale.
narrative.why_spreading: The coin rides a meta that is already proven (brain-sim coins) and adds a familiar dog-coin mascot. The attention looks like a launch-and-migration pump driven by bundlers and bots, not organic discovery. I found no indexed X, Reddit or news discussion of shibabrain itself.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the migrated pump.fun token that the project website/X account (@shibabrain) links to. It has the only large volume, the highest market cap, and a DexScreener profile. The other same-name tokens appeared after it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 same-name clones listed in the packet (e.g., 2GjF5..pump at $55k, and several at $11-16k with near-zero liquidity), most created after this pair. There is also an older ShibaBrain (HRkcW..pump) that has died.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 501 bundler wallets and 973 fresh wallets among traders, a 0.42 bot/degen rate, and 20% of top traders are bundlers. There were 14.6k transactions in the first hour on about $47k of liquidity, i.e. 22x hourly turnover. Many clones launched at the same time. No organic posts were found on any indexed source.
authenticity.uncertainty: X pages returned 402 and the search engines do not index fresh X posts, so there may be real CT discussion I could not see. GMGN counts 41 smart wallets and 3 renowned wallets as traders.

structural_risks: Price is already about 86% below the ATH and fell another 67% in 5 minutes on a live check
Heavy bundler and fresh-wallet presence, so there is sell overhang from bundled supply
9.6% of supply sits in a Streamflow vault (unlock schedule unknown)
The dev has launched 4 tokens from this wallet and 9 from the linked X account, so this is a serial launcher

structured_output.counterargument: The brain-sim meta is real and recent, and FLYBRAIN showed that these coins can re-run. The canonical coin in a meta, after an 85% flush from ATH, sometimes gets a dead-cat bounce of 2x or more if the site's live 'brain' demo goes viral or a KOL posts about it. Pool LP is 100% burned, so the classic LP-pull rug is not possible. Bouncing from about $100k back to $200k+ would only take it to about a quarter of its ATH.

structured_output.thesis: This is a derivative 'Shiba Inu run by a connectome brain' coin riding the FLYBRAIN meta. It already pumped to about $875k after migration and is now collapsing hard (live check: $123k, -67% over 5 minutes, liquidity draining) under heavy bundler and bot flow. The story is thin, the dog-connectome claim looks made up, and I found no organic discussion. A 2x from entry needs a strong bounce against a falling market. That is unlikely but not impossible, given the meta.
